hero.label: Product builder · Engineer · Poet
hero.subline: I build cloud software for a living — Prime Innovators, Vortexme, and open-source tools — and write Urdu poetry for the rest of it. Currently exploring semantic-aware reconciliation of Kubernetes in Digital Twin environments.

about.title: About
about.intro: Full-stack engineer focused on building real products. Poet under the pen name Saeedi.
about.bio: Mohammad Saeed is a product builder and engineer based in Islamabad. He is founding Prime Innovators (an open-source talent ecosystem), shipping Vortexme (FYP flagship), and exploring semantic-aware reconciliation of Kubernetes in Digital Twin environments. Outside the codebase, he writes and records Urdu poetry as Saeed Saeedi.
